title: Design System: Mister Download Manager website

board.purpose: The page, the header, everything between sheets. Text on it: on-board / on-board-2 only.

board-edge.purpose: Hairline under the header and above the closing.

on-board.purpose: Primary text on the board (AA checked).

on-board-2.purpose: Secondary text on the board (AA checked).

paper.purpose: Every sheet, label, menu and dialog.

paper-2.purpose: Hover and selected rows on a sheet; code and quote wells.

ink.purpose: Reading text on sheets, field rules, label bands, footer.

ink-3.purpose: Field names, fine print, captions on sheets.

go.purpose: The Download action and delivered states only.

go-ink.purpose: Text on Dispatch Green; never white.

link.purpose: Links on sheets; the focus ring.

stamp.purpose: Delivered green for text and rules on label stock.

board-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of board. The page, the header, everything between sheets. Text on it: on-board / on-board-2 only.

board-deep-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of board-deep. The closing section.

board-edge-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of board-edge. Hairline under the header and above the closing.

on-board-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of on-board. Primary text on the board (AA checked).

on-board-2-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of on-board-2. Secondary text on the board (AA checked).

paper-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of paper. Every sheet, label, menu and dialog.

paper-2-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of paper-2. Hover and selected rows on a sheet; code and quote wells.

ink-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of ink. Reading text on sheets, field rules, label bands, footer.

ink-2-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of ink-2. Secondary text on sheets.

ink-3-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of ink-3. Field names, fine print, captions on sheets.

line-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of line. Quiet dividers inside a sheet.

link-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of link. Links on sheets; the focus ring.

stamp-dark.purpose: Dark theme value of stamp. Delivered green for text and rules on label stock.

display.purpose: One word or phrase per section at poster scale: the closing line, the race ratio, the 404 number.

page-title.purpose: Inner pages' h1 on the board, max 20ch.

label-headline.purpose: The headline printed on a waybill.

band.purpose: Sender line and sheet name in an ink band.

field-value.purpose: The value under a field name, tabular figures.

field-name.purpose: Uppercase condensed name over a field value, table column heads, help nav groups. Never a kicker.

mono.purpose: Code and the barcode's human-readable line.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Every sheet lying on the board.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Stuck-on things: the waybill, screenshots, menus, the language dialog and offer.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The one easing for things that arrive and settle: label feed, dialog, stamp, bars, press.

motion.name: label-feed
motion.value: 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) .15s; clip-path inset top to bottom plus an 18px drop
motion.purpose: The waybill feeds out once on load, like a thermal printer.

motion.name: stamp-thunk
motion.purpose: The Delivered stamp landing on a finished lane.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: Benchmark speed-up bars growing into view.

motion.name: race
motion.purpose: The tracking race plays at the benchmark's measured times; reduced motion shows the finish at once.

breakpoints.name: nav-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Header links fold into a menu.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: One column; the waybill moves below the window, overlapping its foot.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Field grids stack (the waybill keeps two), segmented tabs stack, comparison rows stack.

chartPalette.purpose: Read by bench.js for the benchmark page's charts only.

narrative.overview:
A download is a delivery. The page is the board the parcel sits on, in the logo's blue; the real app window is the parcel; what the visitor reads is printed on thermal-label sheets stuck to it, in black ink with hairline field rules, ranked like a courier label: who sends it, the headline, the fine print, the fields, a real barcode. The benchmark is tracking: two shipments scanned event by event to the measured times, each event showing its rate as well as its time.

The world is the owner's choice. The blue board (#1f63d6) replaced kraft brown after four rendered options; dark theme is a navy depot where the same labels print in reverse (near-black stock, cool white ink). Density is a label's, not a brochure's: few elements, each one a field with a name and a value, numbers in tabular figures. Every screenshot is the real, unretouched app, shown at full content width; the site never draws a fake window, a glowing mock-up or a row of icon cards. Reading pages (help, FAQ, news, legal) take the same world with restraint: the board above, one sheet to read.

The site ships in 21 languages, Arabic and Persian right to left. Every direction-bound value is a logical property; labels tilt the other way in RTL; only native language names are isolated with `bdi`.
keyCharacteristics: Blue board, white label stock, black ink; green only for Download and delivered.
One self-hosted face, Archivo, condensed by its width axis for headings and field names.
Fields, not cards: name over value, ink rules between.
Real artefacts only: the unretouched app, a scannable Code 128 barcode, the benchmark's own times.
Motion is mechanical and rare: the label feeds out once, progress moves in real time, a stamp lands.

rules.name: The Green By Law Rule
rules.body: Green appears only on the Download action and on delivered states (the done lane, the stamp). Never on a secondary button, a badge, a link or a decorative accent.

rules.name: The Two Text Systems Rule
rules.body: Text on the board is on-board or on-board-2; text on label stock is ink, ink-2 or ink-3. Never put ink on the board or board text on a sheet; every element printed on stock declares ink colour, whatever it inherits.

rules.name: The Colour Lives In Fields Rule
rules.body: Reading text stays ink. Colour belongs to the board, the action, the stamp and links, not to paragraphs or headings.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared (times, sizes, ratios, versions, dates) is set in tabular figures.

rules.name: The Condense, Don't Swap Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Archivo's width and weight axes, never from a second display face. Scripts Archivo lacks fall back to the system's face, without condensing, tracking or uppercase.

rules.name: The Paper On Board Rule
rules.body: Depth means paper on the board. A surface either lies (Sheet) or is stuck on (Lift); there is no third height and no glow.

dos: Do set every page on the board (#1f63d6, navy #0c1a33 in dark) and everything read on paper sheets in ink.
Do keep green for the Download action and delivered states only, with Go Ink text on it.
Do use on-board / on-board-2 for text on the board and ink / ink-2 / ink-3 on sheets; check AA in both themes.
Do present facts as fields: a 12px condensed uppercase name over a 650-weight tabular value, 1.5px ink rules between.
Do show only the real, unretouched app in screenshots, in its day and night versions, left to right even on RTL pages.
Do use logical properties for every direction, mirror tilts in RTL, and drop tracking, uppercase and condensing for Arabic, Persian, Indic, Thai and CJK scripts.
Do keep the barcode a real, scannable Code 128 of what it says.
Do honour reduced motion: the race shows its finish, the label does not feed, bars and grids sit at rest.
donts: Don't use green on secondary buttons, tags, links, icons or decoration.
Don't put ink-coloured reading text directly on the board, or board text on a sheet.
Don't add a second typeface for display; condense Archivo instead.
Don't set a field name above a section headline as a kicker; field names name fields, table columns and nav groups.
Don't add elevations beyond Sheet, Lift and the Download sticker edge (screenshots inside prose take a lighter contact shadow), and never a glow.
Don't draw a mock window, retouch a screenshot or use IDM artwork; IDM appears only as a named, text-marked comparison.
Don't animate anything on entry except the label's single feed and progress moving into place (the race, the speed-up bars, the connection grids).
